provenance.e1_ft_v1: FT-v1: DeepFilterNet3 fine-tuned from pretrained on train_fast (17,303 rows, clipped rows excluded), 2000 steps, batch 16, 3 s, lr 5e-5, frozen BatchNorm, seed 26052; best validation loss at step 2000.
provenance.e2_impulse_e2a: E2-a impulse specialist: fine-tuned from FT-v1 on tier-C rows only (gunfire/explosion/artillery, 2,983 rows), 1000 steps, same settings; step-1000 model (no validation improvement over FT-v1).
provenance.gate_v1_e0_e1.pt: FusionGate for 2 experts (E0 pretrained + E1 FT-v1), 2000 steps on 1,127 val_pool pairs; best validation loss at step 2000. Not loadable for 3 experts.
provenance.E0: pretrained DeepFilterNet3 (deepfilternet 0.5.6 model cache; not part of this folder).
